svg.title: Collapse of the Eastern Bloc (1989–90) and Dissolution of the USSR (1991)
svg.desc: True conic-projection historical atlas map showing the six 1989 Eastern Bloc revolutions across Poland, Hungary, East Germany, Czechoslovakia, Bulgaria, and Romania, the 1990–91 Baltic independence pioneers, German reunification, and the December 1991 dissolution of the Soviet Union into 15 independent states.
